proposals.current_pain_description: Runware is a PAYG (Pay-As-You-Go) service. A recursive loop bug or a misconfigured GitHub Actions matrix run could trigger thousands of API calls, consuming Hugo's entire 20€ monthly budget (or hitting billing limits) in minutes.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a 'circuit_breaker.py' script run at the start of every image generation step. It must read a persistent state file in the repository (e.g., '.github/budget_state.json') tracking the current month's spent credits. If the estimated cost exceeds 18€, the script gracefully forces the workflow to exit with status 0, preventing further API charges.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Avoids unexpected API bills, protects the strict 20€/month budget boundary.

proposals.issue_title: Mobile Download Bottleneck for Generated Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone (Termux). Navigating GitHub's UI to download ZIP artifacts, unzipping them, and uploading them to KDP/Redbubble is slow and frustrating on a mobile screen.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-generation step using a Telegram Bot API curl command. Upon successful pipeline completion, the workflow directly uploads the final PDF/ZIP (under 50MB) to a private Telegram channel/chat. Hugo receives a direct push notification on his phone with a one-click download link.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 5-10 minutes per product upload, making the mobile-only pipeline friction-free.

proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines rely on hardcoded API calls (e.g., Pollinations, Together AI). If a provider goes down, rate-limits, or blocks GitHub Actions IPs, the entire generation pipeline breaks silently.
proposals.proposed_fix: Refactor image generation into a single Python module 'image_gateway.py' that implements a prioritized fallback mechanism: 1. Together AI (free tier) -> 2. Cloudflare Workers AI (free tier) -> 3. Runware (paid fallback, if budget permits) -> 4. Pollinations (free, low-quality fallback). This ensures pipelines never crash due to API downtime.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: 99.9% uptime for image generation without manual code intervention.

proposals.issue_title: Wasted Processing on Defective AI Images
proposals.current_pain_description: AI models generate images with artifacts (extra limbs, broken borders, gray backgrounds instead of clean line art). Currently, these are packaged into books automatically, resulting in low-quality products that will get rejected or refunded.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate 'agent_gemini_quality_check' directly into the image loop. Use the free Gemini 2.5 Flash Vision API to analyze each generated image before saving. Use a prompt like: 'Is this coloring page clean line art with white background, no gray shading, and no physical deformities? Respond strictly YES or NO.' If NO, auto-retry the generation with a tweaked seed.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures near-perfect product quality for KDP/Etsy without manual inspection.

proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality vector/line-art assets generated for a coloring book are only used once. Hugo spends 100% of his effort on one format, ignoring high-margin digital downloads like SVG sticker packs, PNG clip art, or seamless patterns.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a 'cross_pollinate.py' script. When 'produce_coloring_book' outputs high-quality transparent PNGs, this script auto-converts them to SVGs (using potrace/autotrace) and packages them as transparent sticker bundles for Redbubble and digital vector packs for Cults3D/Etsy.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory by 3x for the same hours worked and image budget spent.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions Runner IP Blocks on Scrapers
proposals.current_pain_description: Scraping trends directly from GitHub Actions runners results in HTTP 403/Cloudflare blocks because target websites block known hosting provider IP ranges.
proposals.proposed_fix: Leverage Gemini 2.5 Flash's built-in Google Search grounding capability. Instead of scraping websites directly from the runner, ask Gemini to perform search queries and extract the trend data. This routes requests through Google's search infrastructure, bypassing IP blocks completely.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Restores reliable trend analysis and opportunity hunting capabilities.
